existing_features.title: Reduce the border widths on the Gallery page further — they must be noticeably thinner than the current state (e.g. 1px or 0.5px instead of the current value).
Make the quote text on the Gallery page lighter in font weight (e.g. font-weight: 300 or 400) and switch it to a serif typeface (use the already-loaded Playfair Display font).

projectName: Thinner borders and lighter serif quote font on Gallery page
